reference: Business Vision, Key changes required to reach the vision (supporting architecture, IT oversight)
quote:
Much more enabling than what is currently in the BT offerings.
We need alternatives to Fabric, ability to pick the best tool for the job
Infrastructure in place to support the orchestration of Events to Trigger processing (Automation versus Manual to start)
Cloud to Cloud optimization (i.e. CRA for T1 – Possible Data-In item)
The presence of a system of interoperable statistical registers (person, SbgR, business, activity). This would drastically change the way we would operate survey taking and integrate data. This requires the creation of a unique statistical identifier for every person in Canada.
justification: Event orchestration and alternative architectures directly change how Process automation is designed and operated.
update application to description reason: The Design phase should emphasize flexibility, modularity, support for event-driven and cloud-native architectures, and systemic planning for interoperable registers and unique identifiers, affecting the way workflows and infrastructure are composed.

reference: Business Vision, Key changes required to reach the vision (Informatics / cybersecurity, IT oversight)
quote:
Faster approvals, less red tape to get access to proper environments.
Need to trust our own staff (not limit what Citizen Developers can access)
staff will need to be greatly reduced, mirroring the reduction in staff to build the pipelines
Off-the-shelf offerings won’t need the same maintenance or development
There are way too many stakeholders in IT: DPSD, CyberSEC, BT, EA
justification: Reduced need for maintenance and fewer IT and staff resources suggest a transformation of ongoing operational and support processes in all phases where bespoke systems required constant attention.
update application to description reason: Update to stress reduction of bespoke builds and testing cycles in favor of commercial solutions; reflect streamlined approvals and maintenance processes.
